title: Quasi-derivations of Block Lie algebras $\mathcal{B}(q)$
summary: We compute quasi-derivations of Block Lie algebras $\mathcal{B}(q)$. In particular, we prove that $\mathcal{B}(q)$ has various nontrivial quasi-derivations, i.e., quasi-derivations different from derivations and $δ$-derivations. As corollaries, we obtain a complete description of $δ$-derivations, $δ$-biderivations, and transposed $δ$-Poisson structures on $\mathcal{B}(q)$ for $δ\notin\{0;1\}$.
